violations.statement: Corin shouts a warning to the Pass Guard moments after ringing the Ashbell.
violations.rationale: Corin rang the Ashbell at 19:00 on Day 1 (S02) and shouts a warning moments later; under this rule he has no voice until sunrise.

violations.statement: Ves still cannot speak at noon on Day 4 after ringing the Ashbell.
violations.rationale: Ves rang the Ashbell at 06:00 on Day 4 (S11); under a one-hour rule her voice returns by 07:00, but S13 has her voiceless at noon.
